source: Six learner attempts saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Check whether with comprueba si and review/check sequences
summary: Image instruction retained imagen but adjuncta spelling recurred. Introduced comprueba si; partial readiness response followed by full model and correct function-readiness and ability-check transfers. Review/check sequence left first object implicit, then masculine archivo transfer explicitly kept lo and listo. Accents supplied.

observations.outcome: Correct command, imagen spelling and feminine agreement; adjuncta still had extra c and was corrected. Valid different instruction from current check/publish target. Tutor returned to introduced comprobar → comprueba and comprueba si chunk.
Correct readiness clause as partial response; no learner check command yet. Tutor modelled full Comprueba si el archivo está listo. Do not score as an attempted incorrect conjugation.

observations.learnerText: Comprueba si la funcion esta lista
observations.correctedText: Comprueba si la función está lista.
observations.outcome: Correct first complete comprueba-si instruction after model, transferred to explicit feminine function subject and lista. Accents supplied.
Correct ability meaning, infinitive publicarla and feminine object after podemos without a full target model.

observations.learnerText: Primero revisa; luego comprueba Si esta lista
observations.correctedText: Primero revísala; luego comprueba si está lista.
observations.outcome: Understandable sequence with object left implicit in first revisa. Tutor supplied explicit requested it as revísala while acknowledging contextual omission; reporting clause and lista correct. Capitalization/accent supplied.

observations.learnerText: Primero revisalo; luego comprueba Si esta listo
observations.correctedText: Primero revísalo; luego comprueba si está listo.
observations.outcome: Correct transfer with explicit attached masculine lo for archivo and matching listo. Command base and check clause correct; accents and standard si capitalization supplied.

nextSteps: Use a practical comprueba-si instruction after intervening material
Keep ability meaning and explicit objects where requested
assessmentNote: Partial responses and contextually implicit objects are not labelled wholly ungrammatical. Immediate transfers after models do not establish durable recall.
